rules.baseline: Approved G6 Nifty futures: reject only when slot and session both oppose
rules.recent_and_vwap: Also reject: 15-minute Nifty move opposes by >0.10% and price is adverse to futures VWAP
rules.breadth_opposition: Also reject: >60% of covered F&O futures oppose from open and Nifty 15-minute move opposes
rules.breadth_reversal: Also reject: breadth moves >=10 percentage points against side in 15 minutes and Nifty 15-minute move opposes
rules.session_and_recent: Also reject: Nifty session direction opposes and 15-minute move opposes by >0.05%
rules.chop: Also reject: 30-minute trend efficiency <0.25 (six completed returns required)
rules.chop_high_vol: Also reject: efficiency <0.25 and same-clock realized volatility >1.25x prior-20-session median
rules.high_vol: Also reject: same-clock realized volatility >1.50x prior-20-session median
rules.vwap_crosses: Also reject: at least three futures session-VWAP sign crossings during last 30 minutes
rules.market_extension: Also reject: Nifty extends in trade direction >2 times mean true range of last 14 five-minute bars from VWAP
rules.weak_participation: Also reject: volume <0.70x prior-20-session same-clock median and efficiency <0.35
rules.cross_index_opposition: Also reject: >=3 of Bank, Financial, Midcap and Next50 futures oppose in both session and 15-minute returns

missing_features: Keep approved G6 decision; never interpret missing as zero
selection: Training net >= baseline, losing days and drawdown <= baseline, <=10% baseline positive trade PnL excluded; maximize avoided negative PnL, tie by net PnL. Otherwise baseline.
